brief:
Israeli colonists accompanied by occupation forces stole olive crops from Palestinian land in al-Mughayyir, a village northeast of Ramallah, on Sunday, the Palestine News Network reported. The incident occurred as Palestinian farmers faced escalating attacks during the harvest season across the West Bank.

The theft is part of a broader pattern of settler violence targeting Palestinian agricultural activities in occupied territories.

title: Israeli settlers steal olive crops in al-Mughayyir village
